name.en-US: The Life of a Good Monk

description.la: Libellus de vita boni monachi: de remediis vitiorum, de exemplis eremitarum, de patientia martyrum, de studio doctorum, de labore et oratione, de corona et praemio.
description.en-US: A booklet for the good monk: remedies against vice, the examples of the hermits, the patience of the martyrs, the zeal of the doctors, labour and prayer, the crown and reward. Latin only: Pohl's critical edition (Freiburg 1918), from a raw OCR of the printed volume; no public-domain English translation has been found.
description.pt-BR: Livrinho para o bom monge: remédios contra os vícios, exemplos dos eremitas, paciência dos mártires, zelo dos doutores, trabalho e oração, coroa e prêmio.

sources.edition: Thomae Hemerken a Kempis Vita boni monachi, ed. M. J. Pohl (Freiburg: Herder 1918), Opera omnia IV; archive.org raw OCR (Pohl 1918 volume).
sources.description: Chapters as Pohl divides them, with his upper-case chapter titles recased (u/v normalised by script). Line numbers, running heads and page breaks stripped by script; Pohl's critical footnotes and introduction are not imported. Raw OCR: drop capitals at chapter openings and isolated letters are often garbled; a chapter heading lost to OCR runs two chapters together.
